description: This PHP class, HtmlDumper, is part of the Twig profiling system, specifically used for generating HTML representations of profiling data related to template rendering and execution times.

classes.name: HtmlDumper
classes.description: A final class extending BaseDumper, responsible for rendering profile information as HTML with color highlighting and formatting.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Generates an HTML string representing the profile data, wrapped in <pre> tags.

methods.name: formatTemplate
methods.description: Formats a profile that corresponds to a template, styling it with a background color.

methods.name: formatNonTemplate
methods.description: Formats a profile related to a non-template component, displaying class and method information with styling.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats timing information, displaying duration in milliseconds and percentage with color highlighting.
